# PressZero
> A modern, 100% client-side, zero-knowledge image reducer and compressor engineered for strict file size limits (exact KBs) and maximum privacy.

## Overview
PressZero enables users to compress and resize images to an exact target file size in kilobytes (e.g. 2 KB, 15 KB, 30 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB) without trial-and-error quality guessing. All processing runs entirely inside the user's browser using HTML5 Canvas, Web Workers, and WebAssembly codecs. Images are never uploaded to any server or database.

## Key Capabilities
- [Exact Target-KB Engine](https://presszero.app/#studio): Dual-axis binary search algorithm that bisects quality and adaptively downscales resolution to achieve the target with ±1% precision.
- [Signature & Document Crisp Filter](https://presszero.app/#studio): Adaptive white-point bleaching and ink contrast enhancement to prevent blurry portal rejections for signatures down to 4 KB - 30 KB.
- [Exam & Government Portal Matrix](https://presszero.app/#portal-matrix): 1-click presets for NTA / UGC-NET (10–50 KB signature, 10–200 KB photo), UPSC, SSC, US Visa DS-160 (600x600 px), Schengen Visa, and Passport Seva.
- [Zero-Knowledge Privacy Proof](https://presszero.app/#privacy-manifesto): Verifiable 0 outgoing HTTP requests. Safe for passports, signatures, national IDs, and confidential documents.
- [Batch Processing & ZIP Export](https://presszero.app/#studio): Multi-threaded client-side batch compression with 1-click in-memory ZIP download.
- [PWA & Offline Capability](https://presszero.app): Operates in full airplane mode with 100% functionality.
